newsitem.title: CHINA: BADMINTON-CHINA WITHDRAWS FROM ASIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-CHINA WITHDRAWS FROM ASIAN CUP.

text.p: China's badminton team has pulled out of this month's Asian Cup in Jakarta because it needs time to recuperate after mixed showings in recent tournaments, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
The team would seek to regain its form in preparation for the All-England Open and world championships in May, it said.

China has informed the Asian Badminton Confederation of its decision to withdraw and will be replaced by India in the eight-team Asian Cup in Jakarta on February 19, Xinhua quoted head coach Li Yongbo as saying.
China won five titles in the recent Japan and South Korea Opens, but their men's players were all ousted in the first and second rounds.
"Our two key players Dong Jiong and Sun Jun are totally not on form. Both were eliminated at the first two rounds in the Japan Open," Li Yongbo said.
"We coaches took the matter seriously and our thorough analyses showed that the players had to undergo a recuperation before they could go for any major international events," Li said.
